serverInfo.name: lacuna
serverInfo.title: Lacuna Music
serverInfo.description: Generate AI music from a style description and optional lyrics. Submit a task, poll it, collect the rendered audio.

tools.name: generate_music
tools.title: Generate music
tools.description: Create an AI music generation task on Lacuna. Returns immediately with a `pending` task; poll `get_generation` to retrieve the finished tracks and their audio URLs.

tools.name: get_generation
tools.title: Get generation
tools.description: Retrieve the current state of a music generation task by id. Status is `pending`, `ready`, or `failed`; audio URLs appear on `ready`.

tools.name: list_models
tools.title: List models
tools.description: List the music models available through the API, with their credit cost per task, tracks produced per task, and language coverage.

usage.notes: Each generate_music call spends credits from the authenticated Lacuna account and requires an active Pro plan or higher.
